name: Davinia
source:
Davinia is the main villainess in "My Magical Kindness Made the Prince Fall in Love!!" She's cold, mean, and would do anything to secure a seat in the royal family. However, the new Davinia just wants to get through life without starting trouble. Oh, and to eat all the food she could.

[From [url=https://thechosengiraffe.itch.io/the-villainess-just-wants-to-eat]official profile[/url]]
